provenance.treatment_definition: Compost (7.6 Mg/ha/crop) + cereal rye cover crop every year, low seeding rate (1x)
provenance.monitoring_products: planting v5.0, harvest v5.0, tillage v5.0, irrigation v5.0, fertilization v2.0, crops v4.1
provenance.note: Built from the SOCS management calendar (cal-val-data managements.csv): an event for each operation on its rows (a cover crop irrigation row on each of its application days, a vegetable irrigation row as a drip schedule), plus the termination of each winter cover crop at its spring flail mowing and spading; nothing from the earlier uncertainty#6 fills. Where a row gives a window, the event takes the monitoring product's median day for the crop and operation near SOCS when it falls in the window (imputed), otherwise the window's midpoint (assumed); windows the calendar orders around a planting or harvest are narrowed to the dates chosen for those. Planting leaf C, vegetable irrigation and tillage intensity come from the monitoring product near SOCS (monitoring_near_salinas.csv), the drip interval from the scenarios priors. Harvests remove White et al. 2020b's harvest index (lettuce 0.26, broccoli 0.24) with the rest and the roots to litter; the 2004 spinach, the 2005 broccoli and the cover crops go wholly to litter. Compost C is the published 317 g C kg-1; its N is the calendar's unsourced 15 g N kg-1. See runs/salinas_socs/README.md.
